# Fermentation Science Major at Shady Grove
Source: https://academiccatalog.umd.edu/undergraduate/colleges-schools/universities-shady-grove/fermentation-science/
Fetched: 2026-09-28

## Catalog requirements

Students enrolled in Fermentation Science Major are required to earn a grade of "C-" or better in courses applied toward satisfaction of the major. This includes all the required and elective courses.
